title: Polynomial-time computability of the tableau emitter
statement: For every finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet, the function that maps a Boolean string $w$ to the output produced by the fixed eleven-register program for $M$ after $60(k+1)(L+30)(|w|+1)^3$ steps is polynomial-time computable, where $k$ is the number of work tapes of $M$ and $L$ is the maximum template length for $M$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite Turing machine over Bool
